summary: Forked-env regression verification of Gaminder. Backend connectivity via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is healthy (200 on /api/). 12/13 pytest tests pass. One CRITICAL regression: /api/standout returns 0 profiles for ALL users (including seed novastrike and admin). Frontend Standout screen visibly shows 'No standout profiles yet. Check back soon!'. Root cause: compatibility_v2() weights recently_played_games at 70% and playtime_slots at 10%, but the seed_users() function never populates these fields — max achievable score = top_games(15) + riot(5) = 20, well below MIN_COMPAT_TO_SHOW=50. Same root cause makes swipe-feed match percentages look very low (0–15%) across all seed cards. Frontend login → swipe → matches → profile (with Steam/Riot Connect cards + theme toggle) all render correctly. NovaStrike has the expected pre-seeded mutual match with PixelPanda. No deprecated Expo packages or React Native red-screen errors detected.

critical.issue: Returns 0 profiles for every user, breaking the Standout tab entirely. Root cause: compatibility_v2() at server.py:301 weights recently_played_games 70% and playtime_slots 10%, but seed_users() at server.py:862 only writes top_games — neither recently_played_games nor playtime_slots is ever populated. Max possible score for any seed user pair ≈ 20%; MIN_COMPAT_TO_SHOW=50 (server.py:56) filters them all out. Verified: db.users.findOne({username:'NovaStrike'}) returns no recently_played_games or playtime_slots fields. Same regression silently degrades swipe-feed match_percentage (all seed cards show 0–15% vs. expected 50–90%).

integration_issues.issue: UI correctly handles empty response with 'No standout profiles yet. Check back soon!' but the underlying API never returns profiles (see backend critical issue above).

action_items: Fix seed_users() in /app/backend/server.py (~line 862) to populate recently_played_games (1–3 entries, ideally a subset of the user's top_games) and playtime_slots (1–2 entries from PLAYTIME_SLOTS) for every seeded profile so compatibility_v2() can clear MIN_COMPAT_TO_SHOW=50. After fixing, also delete-and-reseed: either drop existing seed docs (db.users.deleteMany({is_seed:true})) so the startup hook reseeds with the new fields, or add a one-time backfill that $set's these fields on existing seed users.
Consider whether admin@gaminder.app should also receive realistic recently_played_games/playtime_slots so the admin's Standout view is non-empty for QA.
Optional: lower MIN_COMPAT_TO_SHOW or add a fallback (e.g., show top-N by raw score if <3 cross threshold) so the feature degrades gracefully when users haven't filled out the new fields.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:496-509 signup() now writes recently_played_games and playtime_slots, but seed_users() (server.py:862) was never updated to write the same fields — clear oversight in the v2 compatibility rollout.
server.py is 1090 lines — past the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers/auth, routers/swipe, routers/integrations, services/compatibility, services/seed.
MIN_COMPAT_TO_SHOW=50 is a hard cliff with no fallback; a half-empty feed of high-score users is better UX than an empty Standout screen.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing seed users used as-is; identified that they are missing recently_played_games and playtime_slots fields.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes seed_users(), re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_gaming_buddy.py::test_standout -v` and verify the Standout tab in the UI shows >=1 card with match_percentage >= 50 for novastrike@seed.gamingbuddy.app. Also re-check swipe feed scores — they should now exceed 50% for well-matched seed pairs (e.g., NovaStrike ↔ RogueWave both have Valorant + CS2 + Apex). Riot key in /app/backend/.env may have expired (24h dev key) — if test_integrations Riot link fails with auth error, rotate the key. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://active-gamers-2.preview.emergentagent.com is correctly wired in forked env.
rca_of_issue: BUG: /api/standout returns empty profiles list for all users. REPRO: 1) curl -s -X POST $URL/api/auth/login -d '{"email":"novastrike@seed.gamingbuddy.app","password":"seedpass123"}' to get TOKEN. 2) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' $URL/api/standout → {"profiles":[]}. RCA: compatibility_v2() uses 70% weight on recently_played_games overlap and 10% on playtime_slots overlap. seed_users() writes only top_games (max 15%) + has no riot/playtime data. Therefore max score = 15 + riot(5) = 20 < MIN_COMPAT_TO_SHOW(50). MITIGATION: populate recently_played_games and playtime_slots in seed_users() and reseed; or lower the threshold; or add fallback top-N sort when threshold filter returns 0.
